title: SSC Selection Post Xii 2024 History PART-3

questions.question: The tall sculptures on the Bharhut Stupa are the depictions of ____________.
questions.solution:
• Bharhut Yakshas: Yakshas and Yakshinis
  • Art: These tall figures are prime examples of early Sunga-period narrative art.

questions.question: Which of the following Pacts succeeded the Communal Award of 1932?
questions.solution:
• Poona Pact (1932): Gandhi-Ambedkar Pact
  • Agreement: Replaced the Communal Award with reserved seats for depressed classes within the joint Hindu electorate.

questions.question: In which Harappan site was a paved bathroom found?
questions.solution:
• Mohenjodaro Bathroom: Mohenjodaro
  • Sanitation: Harappan houses were famous for their advanced private bathrooms and drainage systems.

questions.question: A primitive form of cultivation called Bewar is practised in which state?
questions.solution:
• Bewar Cultivation: Madhya Pradesh
  • Agriculture: A traditional slash-and-burn (shifting) cultivation method practiced by tribes like the Baigas.
